backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only PIT earnings snapshots and signal-date close OHLCV available before next open. Paper entry is next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The peer-revision candidate source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

hypothesis: Positive PIT EPS-estimate revisions in a correlated same-sector peer may transfer information to unrevised liquid peers that start showing SPY-relative leadership, creating a replayable free-data candidate-pool edge without adding noise tickers.
interpretation: The peer-revision relation source did not clear Gate 4 or the accepted revision/rolling-peer comparators. Do not promote or retune this fixed peer-revision relation on the same frozen windows.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping peer revision threshold, own-revision threshold, correlation, relative-strength, top-N, notional, hold, or cooldown on the same frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Retry only with materially richer PIT analyst fields such as analyst-count trajectory, revenue revision, broker breadth, or closed forward replacement-value rows.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: If rejected, likely causes are sparse PIT revision shocks, revision information already captured by same-ticker revision or price peer-shock helpers, or candidate rows displacing stronger accepted relation rows after costs.

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool/relation alpha: a peer's PIT upward EPS estimate revision can be a fresh expectation shock. A same-sector, rolling-correlated peer that has not itself revised but is starting to outperform SPY may underreact into the next 10 trading days.

2_history_check.exp-20260529-011/exp-20260602-019: SEC/earnings same-sector peer-transfer variants failed or were not sufficient. This run uses PIT analyst-revision shock plus rolling correlation instead of generic same-sector transfer.
2_history_check.exp-20260606-025: Accepted rolling-correlation peer shock helper: EV +0.3845, PnL +$6,107.66. This run must beat it as the relation comparator.
2_history_check.exp-20260609-011: Accepted same-ticker revision+surprise low-extension helper: EV +0.1846, PnL +$2,893.75. This run must beat it.
2_history_check.exp-20260609-024: Early peer earnings sympathy was rejected; this run avoids an earnings-calendar timing retry and uses revision shock rows.
2_history_check.exp-20260610-025: Rejected 7d acceleration/residual-leadership same-ticker revision variant: EV -0.0487, PnL -$1,186.35, 16 trades.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md three canonical windows. Must improve aggregate EV/PnL, have no EV/PnL regression window, pass sample/survival/drawdown/concentration gates, and beat both accepted revision and accepted rolling-peer comparators aggregate and per-window.

prediction.confidence_reason: Direct same-ticker revision persistence/acceleration failed or was sparse, while rolling-correlation peer shock is accepted; this tests a distinct revision-driven relation shock rather than another OHLCV or same-ticker revision threshold.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing OHLCV, revision snapshot, peer relation, or future bars rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes in this scout
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation envelope pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result would need a shared default-off helper that computes the same PIT earnings-snapshot peer revision rows, sector/correlation relation, unrevised-candidate gate, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, cooldown, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily snapshots before any report queue, paper ledger, ranking, sizing, watchlist, or order surface could change.
